title: The base that stopped
text: After the July 2019 earthquakes, China Lake evacuated all nonessential personnel and was declared not mission capable. Aerial photographs showed a lateral offset of three to five feet on a service road. The Navy's damage assessment totaled about 5.2 billion dollars. Replacing the buildings alone would cost about 2.2 billion dollars.

s2.title: Naval Air Weapons Station China Lake
s2.quote: A 7.1 magnitude earthquake on July 5, resulted in the facility being evaluated as "not mission capable". ... found damage totaled $5.2 billion. Replacing buildings alone would cost $2.2 billion.
